content:
maria: Hey team — proposing a new synthetic pattern for the perf harness to better exercise KV warm/cold interactions + kernel selection churn. Working name: \"microburst-echo bowtie\".
jonathan: quick idea sketch?
maria: bowtie = symmetrical microbursts separated by a variable quiet window. each microburst includes an \"echo\": a small number of repeated prefixes to trigger KV reuse + cache eviction interplay. goal: stress long-tail latency and see how kernel selection flips with different seqlens.
kevinp: sounds useful. need to make sure we capture kernel choices per-step in traces. can we dump kernel selection logs + chosen batch sizes?
jonathan: yes, we should capture: timestamp, qps, batch_size, kernel_id, seq_len_distribution, kv_hit_rate, p50/p95/p99 latencies, cpu/gpu utilization. minimal overhead.
sara: for apples-to-apples, run each config on same instance type + pinned model commit, disable autoscaling and fallback routing. also seed RNGs for deterministic prompt generation.
maria: agreed. rough loadgen config I tested locally:
```
pattern: microburst_echo_bowtie
bursts_per_run: 40
burst_qps: [300, 800]   # alternate small/large burst
burst_duration_ms: [120, 80]
quiet_window_ms: [200, 1200]  # variable tail shaping
echo_repeat: 3
echo_prefix_prob: 0.12
seqlen_profile: longtail.json
```
jonathan: nice. echo_repeat small so we exercise prefix cache but not fully saturate. longtail.json should match production token distribution (we have that from analytics).
kevinp: important: include a step to pre-warm KV with a calibrated sweep, and a cold-start variant. Kernel scheduler behavior differs between pre-warm and cold. Add `kv_preheat: true|false` to matrix.
maria: agreed. experiment matrix looks like: 
- kv_preheat: true/false
- quantized: int8/float16
- batch_policy: adaptive/static(8,16,32)
- quiet_window: short/long
- instance_type: g5x.x / a100.x
jonathan: perf-bot can run the matrix and post summarized table. also we should capture per-token tail latencies — the long tail often shows up after token 50 for RLHF-style prompts.
perf-bot: queued job 1938765432-01: running matrix 40 configs, collecting kernel traces + nvprof slices, will post JSON summary and tarball link when complete. :gear: 
oliver: how do we ensure kernel selection is comparable across runs? the runtime may pick different kernels based on observed seqlen. we should pin an initial kernel seed or force a trace-based kernel map.
kevinp: option A: force kernel table from a single profiling run (golden run) and reuse it. Option B: let runtime adapt but capture the decision timeline and annotate traces so we can filter runs that diverge. Both are useful.
sara: for reporting, include an \"apples_to_apples\" baseline run: same model/config but single-threaded sequential requests (no batching) to get raw latency floor. then show improvements/regressions vs that baseline.
maria: yes. also add a small validation harness to replay recorded production traces through generator to verify realism.
jonathan: for analysis, produce plots: p99 over time aligned to bursts, kernel flip events overlay, KV hit rate, and batch sizes. export CSV with columns: ts,qps,batch_size,kernel_id,kv_hit,lat_p50,p95,p99,gpu_mem.
perf-bot: matrix run complete. uploading results to /artifacts/1938765432/microbowtie.tar.gz. Summary: notable kernel flip at burst 12 on a100.x when quiet_window short -> kernel switched from fused-attn-v1 to attentn-slowpath leading to p99 spike + batch collapse.
kevinp: interesting. need to capture input seqlen histogram around burst 12. that flip usually triggered by a 2x increase in median seqlen in the echo set.
maria: I pulled the slice. looks like echos had 3 repeated 128-token prefixes which bumped the local seqlen heuristic. runtime misclassified and chose older kernel.
jonathan: action items:
- kevinp: add stricter kernel-selection telemetry (decision_reason, metrics thresholds).
- sara: update loadgen to include the replay-of-recorded-traces mode and the apples_to_apples baseline run.
- maria: run targeted regression with kv_preheat toggled and quantized variants.
- perf-bot: produce consolidated CSV + svg plots and annotate kernel flip events.
oliver: timeline?
maria: aim to run full matrix overnight, share artifact link and short doc with charts tomorrow AM. if we see consistent p99 regressions when quiet_window short, we'll open a follow-up perf bug and a canary to avoid rollout.
jonathan: small note: add a synthetic \"stutter\" variant where quiet_window is jittered per-burst (to mimic sporadic background traffic). often exposes queuing+batching heuristics.
kevinp: good call. jittered quiet_window and echo_prefix_prob sweep will help isolate KV eviction thresholds.
maria: thanks all. I'll post brief run notes in #eng-runtime once artifacts ready. :thumbsup:
